FAR 6.302-2(d) limits the total period of performance of a contract awarded using the “unusual and compelling urgency” authority so that it “May not exceed the time necessary” to meet the urgent need and to allow the agency to enter into a competitive contract, and “May not exceed one year, including all options, unless the head of the agency determines that exceptional circumstances apply.” That determination must be documented in the contract file. [R1] (See also FAR 18.104 cross-reference to 6.302-2.) [R2]

For a $50 million Department of Defense contract (over $20 million, and for DoD not exceeding $150 million), the justification must be approved in writing “by the head of the procuring activity, or a designee who—(i) If a member of the armed forces, is a general or flag officer; or (ii) If a civilian, is serving in a position in a grade above GS-15 under the General Schedule (or in a comparable or higher position under another schedule).” [R1]. Also note the contracting officer must obtain the approval required by 6.304 before award. [R3]

(This follows FAR 6.304(a)(3) and applies because DoD’s higher threshold extends the bracket to “not exceeding $150 million.” See also FAR 6.303-1 on obtaining the approval required by 6.304 [R4].)

The FAR requires that the justification for other than full and open competition be made publicly available “within 14 days after contract award,” except: (a) for awards permitted under 6.302-2 the justification “shall be posted within 30 days after contract award,” and (b) for a brand name justification under 6.302-1(c) the justification “shall be posted with the solicitation.” The justifications must be made publicly available at the Government Point of Entry (GPE) https://www.sam.gov and on the agency’s website (which may link to the GPE), and “Must remain posted for a minimum of 30 days.”

The FAR requires that the justification for other than full and open competition be made publicly available as follows:

- Except as provided in paragraphs (b) and (c), the justification shall be made publicly available within 14 days after contract award [R1].
- For a contract award permitted under 6.302-2, the justification shall be posted within 30 days after contract award [R1].
- For a brand name justification under 6.302-1(c), the justification shall be posted with the solicitation [R1].
